Standards and obligations, country by country.

Each country has its own law and assessment method. We audit against the standard that applies to your organisation.

The countries where we work

FR

France

European Union

  • RGAA, 106 criteria
  • Law of 11 February 2005, article 47, and European Accessibility Act
All about France

BE

Belgium

European Union

  • EN 301 549 and WCAG, level AA
  • Law of 19 July 2018, regional and community texts, EAA
All about Belgium

LU

Luxembourg

European Union

  • RAWeb for the web, RAAM for mobile
  • Law of 28 May 2019 and European Accessibility Act
All about Luxembourg

CH

Switzerland

Outside the European Union

  • eCH-0059, based on WCAG
  • Disability Discrimination Act, cantonal rules, EAA for the EU market
All about Switzerland

The European foundation

Beyond national standards, two European texts shape our clients’ obligations.

EN 301 549

The harmonised European standard setting accessibility requirements for digital products and services, aligned with WCAG.

EAA

The European Accessibility Act, in force since 28 June 2025, which extends obligations to many private-sector products and services.

Which standard applies to you? Let’s talk.
